text:
{kind} {name}: the name breaks the naming rules.
A name starts with a lowercase letter and has at most 63 ASCII letters and digits.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses a model that breaks a rule on its own: a name breaks the naming rules. `kind` is a core.nameKind text; `name` is the name, after its collection's for a name in a collection. Opening with such a lock shows it after error.lockInvalid's colon.
